local getRifleData = data
local capturedKeybindOptionData = data

local function getRifle(getRifleCondition)
	if capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Enabled then
		if getRifleCondition then
			local lower = getRifleCondition.Name:lower()

			if not lower:find("shotgun") and not lower:find("sg") and not lower:find("double barrel") then
				if not lower:find("pistol") and not lower:find("revolver") then
					if not lower:find("rifle") and not lower:find("ar") and not lower:find("ak") then
						return capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Default
					end

					return capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Rifle
				end

				return capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Pistol
			end

			return capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Shotgun
		end

		return capturedKeybindOptionData.WeaponSpecificCooldown.Default
	end

	return capturedKeybindOptionData.ClickCooldown
end

local targetData = data

local function getTargetParts(getTargetPartsCondition)
	if getTargetPartsCondition then
		local timestamp = tick()

		if
			not getPartsData[getTargetPartsCondition]
			or not (timestamp - getPartsData[getTargetPartsCondition].time < 2)
		then
			local firstChilds = {}

			for _, item in ipairs(getTargetPartsData) do
				local firstChild = getTargetPartsCondition:FindFirstChild(item)

				if firstChild then
					table.insert(firstChilds, firstChild)
				end
			end

			getPartsData[getTargetPartsCondition] = {
				parts = firstChilds,
				time = timestamp,
			}

			return firstChilds
		end

		return getPartsData[getTargetPartsCondition].parts
	end

	return {}
end

local capturedUserInputService = UserInputService
local capturedCurrentCamera = CurrentCamera

local function handleTarget(getTargetPartsCondition)
	if targetData.AllBodyPartsCheck then
		local targetData = getTargetParts(getTargetPartsCondition)

		if #targetData ~= 0 then
			local item = nil
			local magnitude = 1e999
			local MouseLocation = capturedUserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

			for _, secondaryItem in ipairs(targetData) do
				if secondaryItem.Transparency < 1 then
					local vector, targetFlag = capturedCurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(secondaryItem.Position)

					if targetFlag and vector.Z > 0 then
						local Magnitude = (Vector2.new(vector.X, vector.Y) - MouseLocation).Magnitude

						if Magnitude < magnitude then
							item = secondaryItem
							magnitude = Magnitude
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return item
		end

		return nil
	end

	return nil
end

local capturedPlayers = Players
local capturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
local capturedDelaySecOptionData = data

local function handler(ragdollContainer)
	if ragdollContainer then
		local Humanoid = ragdollContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if Humanoid then
			if not (Humanoid.Health <= capturedTargetData.HealthThreshold) then
				if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
					if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
						local Ragdoll = ragdollContainer:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll")

						if not Ragdoll or not Ragdoll:IsA("BoolValue") or Ragdoll.Value ~= true then
							return true
						end

						return false
					end

					return false
				end

				return false
			end

			return false
		end

		return false
	end

	return false
end
local function secondaryHandler(gsubCondition)
	if capturedGetRifleData.WeaponWhitelist.Enabled then
		if gsubCondition then
			local gsub = gsubCondition.Name:lower():gsub("[%[%]%- ]", "")

			for _, item in ipairs(capturedGetRifleData.WeaponWhitelist.Weapons) do
				if gsub:find(item:lower():gsub("[%[%]%- ]", ""), 1, true) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		return false
	end

	return true
end
local function alternateHandler(modelCondition)
	if modelCondition then
		local Model = modelCondition:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

		if Model then
			local player = capturedPlayers:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Model)

			if player then
				if player ~= capturedLocalPlayer then
					if
						not capturedDelaySecOptionData.TeamCheck
						or not player.Team
						or not capturedLocalPlayer.Team
						or player.Team ~= capturedLocalPlayer.Team
					then
						if not capturedDelaySecOptionData.AliveCheck or handler(Model) then
							if
								capturedDelaySecOptionData.ShootThroughFF
								or (
									not capturedDelaySecOptionData.IgnoreForceField
									or Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") == nil
								)
							then
								if Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
									local gsubCondition = capturedLocalPlayer.Character
										and capturedLocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

									if secondaryHandler(gsubCondition) then
										return true
									end

									return false
								end

								return false
							end

							return false
						end

						return false
					end

					return false
				end

				return false
			end

			return false
		end

		return false
	end

	return false
end

local localValuePlayer = LocalPlayer

local function getIsValidRifle(lowerCondition)
	if getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Enabled then
		if lowerCondition then
			local lower = lowerCondition.Name:lower()

			if not lower:find("shotgun") and not lower:find("sg") then
				if not lower:find("pistol") and not lower:find("revolver") then
					if not lower:find("rifle") and not lower:find("ar") and not lower:find("ak") then
						return getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Default
					end

					return getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Rifle
				end

				return getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Pistol
			end

			return getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Shotgun
		end

		return getRifleData.WeaponSpecificFOV.Default
	end

	return getRifleData.MaxDistance
end
local function isValid(input)
	local Character = localValuePlayer.Character

	if Character then
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if HumanoidRootPart then
			local Model = input:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

			if Model then
				local humanoidRootPart = Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart then
					local Tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

					return getIsValidRifle(Tool) >= (HumanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
				end

				return false
			end

			return false
		end

		return false
	end

	return false
end
local updateInstancePropertiesData = data
local capturedLocalValuePlayer = LocalPlayer

local function updateInstanceProperties(input)
	if updateInstancePropertiesData.CheckForWalls then
		local Character = capturedLocalValuePlayer.Character

		if Character then
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

			raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
			raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
				Character,
				currentCamera,
			}

			local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(
				currentCamera.CFrame.Position,
				input.Position - currentCamera.CFrame.Position,
				raycastParams
			)

			if not raycastResult then
				return false
			end

			return raycastResult.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") ~= input:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
local currentCamera = CurrentCamera
local players = Players
local secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer

function FindNearestEnemy()
	local secondaryPlayer = nil
	local magnitude = 1e999
	local magnitudeNumber = Vector2.new(currentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, currentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
	local CFramePosition = currentCamera.CFrame.Position

	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer and player.Character then
			local Character = player.Character
			local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if
				Humanoid
				and HumanoidRootPart
				and Humanoid.Health > 1
				and Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
			then
				local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

				raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
				raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
					secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer.Character,
				}

				local raycastResult =
					workspace:Raycast(CFramePosition, HumanoidRootPart.Position - CFramePosition, raycastParams)

				if not raycastResult or raycastResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					local vector, condition = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(HumanoidRootPart.Position)

					if condition then
						local Magnitude = (magnitudeNumber - Vector2.new(vector.X, vector.Y)).Magnitude

						if Magnitude < magnitude then
							magnitude = Magnitude
							secondaryPlayer = player
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return secondaryPlayer
end
function disconnectHealthHook()
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end

local capturedToggle = secondaryToggle

function hookEnemyDetection(secondaryPlayer)
	disconnectHealthHook()

	if secondaryPlayer.Character then
		local Humanoid = secondaryPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if Humanoid then
			connection = Humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(argument)
				if argument <= 1 then
					capturedFlag = false
					player = nil
					capturedToggle:Set(false)
					disconnectHealthHook()
				end
			end)
			Humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
				if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
					capturedFlag = false
					player = nil
					capturedToggle:Set(false)
					disconnectHealthHook()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		return
	end
end

local Heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat
local secondaryCapturedToggle = secondaryToggle
local secondaryCapturedCurrentCamera = CurrentCamera

Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not capturedFlag or not player or not player.Character then
		return
	end

	local HumanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not HumanoidRootPart or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 1 then
		capturedFlag = false
		player = nil
		secondaryCapturedToggle:Set(false)
		disconnectHealthHook()

		return
	end

	local Magnitude = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - secondaryCapturedCurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
	local num = capturedNumNumber
	local flag = nil
	local HeadVelocity = nil
	local HeadVelocityX = nil
	local secondaryFlag = nil

	if not (Magnitude >= 90) then
		if not (Magnitude >= 70) then
			if Magnitude >= 50 then
				num = capturedNumNumber + 0.005
			end
		else
			num = capturedNumNumber + 0.01
		end
	else
		num = capturedNumNumber + 0.02
	end

	local findNearestEnemy = player

	if not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
		secondaryFlag = false
		flag = true
	end

	if not flag then
		HeadVelocity = findNearestEnemy.Character.Head.Velocity
	end

	repeat
		if flag or (flag or not (HeadVelocity.Y < -70)) then
			if not flag then
				if not flag then
					HeadVelocityX = HeadVelocity.X
				end
			end

			if flag or (flag or not (math.abs(HeadVelocityX) > 450) and not (HeadVelocity.Y > 60)) then
				if not flag then
					if not flag then
						secondaryFlag = nil
					end
				end

				flag = false

				local sum

				if not secondaryFlag then
					sum = HumanoidRootPart.Position + HumanoidRootPart.Velocity * num
				else
					sum = HumanoidRootPart.Position + Humanoid.MoveDirection * Humanoid.WalkSpeed * num
				end

				local CFramePosition = secondaryCapturedCurrentCamera.CFrame.Position

				secondaryCapturedCurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(CFramePosition:Lerp(sum, capturedNum), sum)

				return
			end
		end

		secondaryFlag = true
		flag = true
	until not flag
end)

local secondaryFlag = true
local Stepped = RunService.Stepped
local alternateCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer

Stepped:Connect(function()
	local option = alternateCapturedLocalPlayer.Character
		and alternateCapturedLocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

	if player and player.Character then
		local Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if Humanoid and Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and option and secondaryFlag then
			secondaryFlag = false

			local delay = task.delay
			local capturedOption = option

			delay(0.17, function()
				capturedOption:Activate()
				task.delay(0.33, function()
					secondaryFlag = true
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end)

local capturedMouse = Mouse
local additionalCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
local capturedGetRifle = getRifle

RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if capturedTeamCheckOptionData.Enabled then
		if capturedTeamCheckOptionData.UseThrottledUpdates then
			local timestamp = tick()

			if timestamp - capturedTimestamp < capturedTeamCheckOptionData.ThrottleInterval then
				return
			end

			capturedTimestamp = timestamp
		end

		local Target = capturedMouse.Target

		if capturedTeamCheckOptionData.AllBodyPartsCheck and Target then
			local Model = Target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

			if Model then
				local target = handleTarget(Model)

				if target then
					Target = target
				end
			end
		end

		if alternateHandler(Target) then
			if isValid(Target) then
				if not updateInstanceProperties(Target) then
					local Model = Target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

					if not capturedTeamCheckOptionData.InstantShoot then
						if Model ~= capturedModel then
							capturedModel = capturedModel or (Model or false)

							local lowerCondition = additionalCapturedLocalPlayer.Character
								and additionalCapturedLocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

							if capturedGetRifle(lowerCondition) <= tick() - number then
								mouse1click()
								number = tick()
							end
						end
					else
						if Model ~= capturedModel then
							capturedModel = Model
							flag = true
						end

						if flag then
							local lowerCondition = additionalCapturedLocalPlayer.Character
								and additionalCapturedLocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

							if capturedGetRifle(lowerCondition) <= tick() - number then
								mouse1click()
								number = tick()

								return
							end
						end
					end

					return
				end

				flag = false
				capturedModel = nil

				return
			end

			flag = false
			capturedModel = nil

			return
		end

		flag = false
		capturedModel = nil

		return
	end

	flag = false
	capturedModel = nil
end)

local InputBegan = UserInputService.InputBegan
local capturedWallCheckOptionData = data
local alternateCapturedToggle = secondaryToggle

InputBegan:Connect(function(input, flag)
	if not flag then
		local Keybind = capturedWallCheckOptionData.Keybind

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode[Keybind] then
			capturedWallCheckOptionData.Enabled = not capturedWallCheckOptionData.Enabled
			toggle:Set(capturedWallCheckOptionData.Enabled)
		end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode[text] then
			capturedFlag = not capturedFlag
			alternateCapturedToggle:Set(capturedFlag)

			if not capturedFlag then
				player = nil
				disconnectHealthHook()
			else
				player = FindNearestEnemy()

				if player then
					hookEnemyDetection(player)

					return
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end
end)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	flag = false
	capturedModel = nil
	player = nil
	getPartsData = {}
	disconnectHealthHook()

	if capturedFlag then
		task.wait(0.1)
		player = FindNearestEnemy()

		if player then
			hookEnemyDetection(player)
		end
	end
end)
